description: This Java class named 'ManifestProvider' implements a Function that returns a manifest string for a given object. It either retrieves the manifest via the 'WithManifest' interface or returns the simple class name if the object does not implement 'WithManifest'. The class follows singleton pattern with a private constructor and static getInstance method.

classes.name: ManifestProvider
classes.description: A singleton class providing a string manifest of an object, either by retrieving it from the object if it implements 'WithManifest' or by returning its class simple name.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ManifestProvider.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the manifest provider logic to the given object: returns its manifest if it implements 'WithManifest' or its class simple name.
